stages.completion_condition: Return TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object matching tekroo.feature-refinement/1.0.0 with result_type FEATURE_REFINEMENT, acceptance_criteria_disposition PRESERVE_SUBMITTED, clarification_questions, and priority. The refinement preserves submitted acceptance criteria and makes material ambiguity explicit.

Return TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object matching tekroo.feature-specification/1.0.0 with result_type FEATURE_SPECIFICATION, stories containing title, description, acceptance_criteria, and priority, plus design_constraints. The smallest finite set of independently useful stories covers every submitted acceptance criterion.

Return TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object matching tekroo.feature-plan/1.0.0 with result_type FEATURE_PLAN, architecture, design_decisions, assumptions, and an acyclic tasks array. Each task declares story_index, title, description, acceptance_criteria, backward depends_on indexes, empty validates, purpose IMPLEMENTATION, complexity, risk, critical_path, attempt_limit, and review_round_limit. The plan is repository-grounded, uses true dependencies, preserves layer ownership, and contains only work needed for the accepted feature.
